label_ru: Предсказанная нагрузка TRIBE v2 (запасной прогон на Mac, модальности: audio, text). Не измерение мозга.
model_version: facebook/tribev2 best.ckpt (f894e78), cortex fsaverage5 only; run on Mac M5 16 GB
atlas: Schaefer-2018 400 parcels / Yeo 7 networks (volumetric, vol_to_surf) + Destrieux surface atlas, fsaverage5

domain_notes.episodic_memory: low reliability: Yeo Default network + parahippocampal/precuneus/posterior cingulate cortex; no hippocampus (public checkpoint outputs cortex only); model is passive perception, not memory success
domain_notes.word_access: left IFG (triangular, orbital) + left lateral/superior temporal, middle temporal, temporal pole (Destrieux); perception of speech, not production
domain_notes.phrase_building: left IFG (opercular, triangular) + left superior/middle temporal + angular (Destrieux); overlaps with word_access
domain_notes.attention: Yeo Dorsal Attention + Ventral Attention + Frontoparietal control networks, both hemispheres
domain_notes.processing_speed: proxy of stimulus tempo (words/s or tone events/s, rank-scaled), not a brain-based value

modality_details.audio: audio (Wav2Vec-BERT 2.0 -> TRIBE v2), stimulus = Russian voice-over (macOS say) of the instruction and spoken material; tone sequences for auditory tasks
modality_details.text: text (Llama-3.2-3B, unsloth mirror -> TRIBE v2), stimulus = words with approximate timings (proportional to characters)

metadata.visual_only_exercises_note: exercises whose task is visual/motor have only a voice-over of the instruction as stimulus; their values describe the instruction, not the task
metadata.method: mean predicted response over domain vertices, first 5 s dropped, z across 25 stimuli, clip [-2,2], (z+2)/4; modalities averaged
metadata.built_with: Built with Llama (weights from unsloth/Llama-3.2-3B mirror, Llama 3.2 Community License)
metadata.license: TRIBE v2 CC BY-NC 4.0, non-commercial prototype; Meta FAIR, d'Ascoli et al. 2026 arXiv 2605.04326
